text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
“—And that concludes the nutritional 
field-verification plan. It should prove 
useful for the future as well.”
choice_data_list: Yeah. I think that's a good idea.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Then we shall stick to meals based on this 
policy for the time being.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
choice_data_list:
...Your stomach seems to be saying 
otherwise, though.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
N-No... This is fine. It's all according 
to calculations.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
So the rumors about you cooking all your 
meals yourself lately were true, then.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Chicken breast and broccoli... That's 
certainly nutritious, but... is it enough?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Finally... I can finally eat this.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Even if it was her own doing, the price 
of gaining weight to the absolute limit 
was sheer misery..."
choice_data_list:
So you really were on a diet these past 
two weeks, huh.

So you really were on a diet these past 
two weeks, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
................How long have you been 
standing there?
choice_data_list:
Ever since she sat down looking so 
happy...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cesario had her secret diet found out. I 
decided to enjoy the sight of her 
bashfully stuffing her cheeks with sweets 
for a little while.
